body.name: Learner-rate and direction-correlation comparison handle
body.construction: Translate Yu (2026), Assumption 4 and Theorem 1 into Hölder sieve rates while retaining \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}(P)\) as a separate applicability restriction. For Dhawan, Guo and Shah (2026), take their predictor to be \(U=(A,X)\), identity-link squared loss, ambient class \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm{DGS},P}=L^2(P_U)\), and null class \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{DGS}}\); first derive \(f_P^*\), \(s_P\), and \(\xi_P\) from the two \(L^2\) projections. Compare Corollary 2 only on laws satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\), and obtain any claimed strict non-inclusion from an explicit sequence in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\), using dense orthogonal bump packs for vanishing correlation and a single aligned direction for positive correlation.
